snippet.title: Yooka-Replaylee | Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Yooka-Replaylee leaps into action on October 9th, 2025! Coming to PC, PS5, Xbox Series and Nintendo Switch 2!

The reimagined 3D platforming collectathon will be bringing double the content, a bunch of thoughtful upgrades and loads of brand-new surprises! 

Wishlist Yooka-Replaylee on:
Steam: https://bit.ly/4e1LeBY
PS5: https://bit.ly/4e2rb6l
Xbox: https://bit.ly/4lWT58y
